summary: @or-sdk/druid preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs (itself using obfuscator.io-style hex-identifier obfuscation) downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods +x, and executes the shipped file `math_init.js` under that Bun binary via execFileSync. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-bundled artifact (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose code is heavily obfuscated with string-array rotation (function `WV8StW`, decoder `hc1jfK9`) and hex-named identifiers; no source or documentation for the payload is included in the tarball. The package's advertised purpose is a thin Druid query SDK, which does not require pulling an alternate language runtime at install time or executing an opaque bundled payload. The result is that on `npm install`, an obfuscated payload runs on the installer's machine under a runtime the installer did not choose, with the payload's actual behavior hidden from Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
